description: We’re LunaLupa, a team from Thrissur, Kerala, building a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer—a playful web game where young learners experience astronaut training through docking, spacewalk safety, Moon exploration, and emergency drills. Our prototype combines fun gameplay with verified NASA facts, badges, and graduation certificates. We aim to expand with Artemis and Mars missions. We welcome teammates skilled in coding, AI, UI/UX, animation, game design, and educational storytelling!
